card.name: Digits in clock times and doses
card.fires_on: A digit that starts or sits inside a number, most often the hour in a clock time just before a.m. or p.m. It also fires on leading digits of dose or temperature numbers before a unit.

modes.label: Hour of a clock time
modes.description: A digit for the hour right before a.m., p.m., or PM.
modes.example: Just before <<9>> a.m. EST, however, abnormal

modes.label: Digit in a dose or temperature
modes.description: The first or middle digit of a number in parentheses that is followed by mg or degrees.

card.writes: It promotes short unit-like pieces such as p, min, w, h, d, which fit what follows a number: p.m., minutes, px.
card.plain: It spots a digit in the middle of a time or dose number, where a unit like p.m. or mg comes next.
